page.overview:
What is Anguirel?

Anguirel was one of the two swords forged by Eöl, the Dark Elf, from meteoric iron. Both swords were black and could cleave through all iron found on Arda. Eöl gave Anguirel's mate, Anglachel, to Thingol as payment for being allowed to live in Nan Elmoth. He kept Anguirel as his weapon until it was stolen by his son Maeglin,

Christopher Tolkien notes that Anguirel contains the Sindarin element ang ("iron"). The second element might be uir ("fiery") and related to the root UR ("heat, be hot"). Given that the last element is êl ("star"), the name is likely to mean "Iron-of-the-fiery-star".
